reading.zh: 写入侧：签名记录只追加（append），哈希覆盖含 CA 预留字段（hash），由数据库触发器与应用层双重保证不可修改删除（immutable）；读取侧：记录查询与鉴权下载（query），签名图与附件的私有存储、上传限制与 sha256 校验统一由 file-integrity 承担。
reading.en: Write side: records are appended only (append), the hash covers the reserved CA fields (hash) and triggers plus application discipline forbid mutation (immutable). Read side: query and authenticated download (query), while private storage, upload limits and sha256 checks for images and attachments sit in file-integrity.
